mentions.name: Steampunk Clock (spirograph-based web clocks)
mentions.description: A set of three spirograph-based web clocks presented at steampunkclock.com, with direct access to the Mobius clock and to the Day Spiral clock, which displays local sunrise and sunset times on a 12-hour clock face using a two-turn spiral to fit 24 hours of information into the 12-hour dial.
mentions.source_excerpt: Check out my https://steampunkclock.com!  That's weird for you - based on the spirograph concept.  There are actually three clocks in there; you can get to the others directly at https://mobiusclock.com and the most useful one, https://dayspiral.com that shows your local time of sunrise and sunset, all with a 12-hour clock face. How did I cram 24 hours of info into a 12 hour clockface, you ask? I used a 2-turn spiral!
